Auto-answered by the orchestrator clarify-respond workflow.

DECISIONS:
Q1: A
Q2: A

RATIONALE:
Q1: Option A covers both likely causes. The resolver currently refuses a path without saying which one or why. The manifest union in `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:228-231,298-300` only handles two-sided content conflicts and lets delete/modify shapes through. Those shapes reach the resolver, whose sandbox always refuses `.ai` paths (`scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:22`). Option B would leave a known gap open. Option C's extra symlink check is not supported by the evidence, so it would widen scope. `.ai` stays excluded from the sandbox, and every other refused path still fails closed.
Q2: Option A. The manifest is a generated, sorted, unique-line list that `workspace_init.sh` rebuilds on the next run. Keeping the side that still has the file loses no inventory lines and produces a deterministic result. Option B could silently drop the PR's additions. Option C keeps the same fail-closed outcome that caused this heal.

EXECUTION PLAN (required for any non-letter decision):
Q1:
  strategy: derive_from_repo
  inputs:
    - scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh (manifest union block, lines 203-304; stage check at 244-246; fall-through at 298-300)
    - scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh (the final conflicted-path admission check that emits `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK role=CONFLICT_RESOLVER reason=sandbox_path_unsupported`; it exists on target branch `claude/replace-claude-sessions-phase-5d` but not in this checkout)
    - scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py (EXCLUDED set at line 22, which includes ".ai"; admission checks)
    - tests/test_conflict_manifest_union_contract.py
  steps:
    - In review_untrusted_workspace.py's path admission check, emit one line per refused path: `REVIEW_UNTRUSTED_PATH_REJECTED path=<path> rule=<excluded_dir|symlink|unsafe_path|...>`. Sanitize the path to printable ASCII and cap it at 200 characters. Never print file contents. Keep the exit code and fail-closed behaviour unchanged.
    - In review_conflict_resolve.sh, stop suppressing that diagnostic. Forward at most 10 of the bounded lines to stderr before the existing `::error::Conflict resolver isolation unavailable (reason=sandbox_path_unsupported)` line. Keep `reason=sandbox_path_unsupported` and the existing log prefixes exactly as they are.
    - In review_conflict_prepare.sh, keep the existing two-sided union path unchanged. Add a branch for delete/modify shapes, where only one of index stages 2 and 3 is present: write the surviving stage's content, sorted and unique under `LC_ALL=C` and with blank lines removed (see Q2), then run `git add` on it and recompute RESOLVER_ALLOWLIST_FILE as the current code does. Do not add or change any `.ai` admission.
    - Keep the integration-sync exclusion (`orchestrator/project-*`) and the CONFLICT_MANIFEST_UNION_ENABLED kill switch as they are. The new branch sits inside the same guarded block.
    - Regression test 1: create a scratch repo where one side deletes the manifest and the other changes it, and also put one other file in conflict. Run the prepare logic. Assert that the manifest is staged with no unmerged entry, that RESOLVER_ALLOWLIST_FILE lists only the other file, and that no other `.ai/*` file is admitted. Run it against head 07305da (expected to fail) and with the fix (expected to pass), and record both results in the PR.
    - Regression test 2: refuse a `.ai/other.txt` conflict path and assert that the sanitized rule line appears and the run still fails closed.
  replaces_acceptance_criterion: n/a
  equivalence_argument: This removes the most likely deterministic cause without loosening the sandbox. Any other refused path is still blocked, now with its name and rule in the log.
  reversibility: CONFLICT_MANIFEST_UNION_ENABLED=false disables the new branch together with the existing union. The diagnostic changes only add log output.
Q2:
  strategy: derive_from_repo
  inputs:
    - scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh lines 247-261 (existing sort/comm/sed pipeline)
  steps:
    - When only stage 2 or only stage 3 is present, take that stage's content with `git show :<n>:<path>`, sort and deduplicate it under `LC_ALL=C`, and remove blank lines. Write it to the manifest path and stage it with `git add`.
    - Log `Manifest union-merge: resolved <path> delete/modify (kept stage <n>); <k> unmerged path(s) remain.`
    - If no stage 2 or 3 entry exists, keep the current fall-through message.
  replaces_acceptance_criterion: n/a
  equivalence_argument: The manifest is a generated list that is rebuilt anyway. Keeping the surviving side keeps every line one side added and avoids handing a `.ai` path to the sandbox.
  reversibility: Removing the branch, or setting CONFLICT_MANIFEST_UNION_ENABLED=false, restores the current fail-closed behaviour.

Assumptions and notes:
- The `sandbox_path_unsupported` admission code exists only on the target branch `claude/replace-claude-sessions-phase-5d`, not in this checkout. The implementer must apply both changes on that branch.
- PR #6209's head branch is not `orchestrator/project-*`, so a delete/modify shape is the likely way the manifest got past the union. The final `conflicted_paths.txt` would confirm this but is not available. The new sanitized refusal reason makes any future cause visible.
